usageNotes: Returns the list of available subdirectories under the /access endpoint, functioning as a discovery index for the access and authentication subsystem. No privileges are required — any authenticated user or API token can call it. Useful as a sanity check that the API is reachable and to enumerate supported auth sub-resources before drilling into specific endpoints like /access/users or /access/roles.
tips: The returned 'subdir' values map directly to child endpoints (e.g., 'users', 'groups', 'roles', 'acl', 'domains', 'ticket') — use them to discover what's available without hardcoding paths.
Because this endpoint requires no special privilege, it is safe to use as a lightweight connectivity/health probe against the PVE API.
